title: GitWeave Copier Module
description: Metadata schema for copier.yaml files in GitWeave template modules

_metadata.description: Module metadata required in every GitWeave template module

name.description: Unique snake_case identifier for the module (must start with a lowercase letter)

version.description: CalVer version string in YYYYMMDD.Patch format (e.g. 20240101.0)

description.description: Human-readable description of the module's purpose

min_copier_version.description: Minimum copier version required to use this module (e.g. 8.0.0)

parent.description: Name of the parent module for composition (snake_case)
